{{Top|leg}}
A '''broad-band comlink''' was a type of [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]]. It was installed in [[Mark IV sentry droid/Legends|Mark IV sentry droids]], where it was coded to local [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] communications frequencies.<ref name="SWTSE">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref>
